title: working with other people
goal: C3 Pull requests, review, and the hygiene that keeps a shared branch usable
startWith: A repo with a remote you share, or a fork of a public one.

newIdeas.plain: In a fork workflow origin is your fork and upstream is the project.
A pull request open for feedback before it is finished.
A commit with a verifiable author, via an SSH or GPG key.

tasks.do: Set up a fork with two remotes and keep it current

blocks.label: terminal
blocks.body:
git remote add upstream https://github.com/org/project.git
git fetch upstream
git switch main && git rebase upstream/main && git push

tasks.do: Open a pull request from the command line

blocks.label: terminal
blocks.body:
git switch -c feat/thing
# ... commits ...
git push -u origin feat/thing
gh pr create --fill --draft
gh pr view --web

blocks.label: IntelliJ
blocks.body: The Pull Requests tool window (GitHub plugin) lists, reviews and merges PRs in the IDE, inline review comments included.

blocks.label: terminal
blocks.body:
gh pr checkout 123
git diff main...HEAD
git log --oneline main..HEAD

tasks.do: Keep the branch reviewable while review is happening
tasks.why: Force-pushing a rebased branch mid-review destroys the reviewer's “what changed since I looked”. Add fixups, squash at the end.

blocks.label: terminal
blocks.body:
git commit --fixup=<hash> && git push          # reviewable increments
# once approved:
git rebase -i --autosquash origin/main && git push --force-with-lease

blocks.label: terminal
blocks.body:
git config --global gpg.format ssh
git config --global user.signingkey ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
git config --global commit.gpgsign true
git log --show-signature -1

proof.expect: the commits your PR would contain
proof.note: Your branch is one readable change.

doneWhen: You can open, update and land a PR without leaving the terminal or the IDE.

lessons.title: Pull Requests in the IDE
lessons.teach: With the GitHub plugin, the Pull Requests tool window lists PRs, checks out a branch in one click, and takes review comments inline on the diff — the review half of step 09 without a browser.
lessons.fallbackTip: gh pr list / gh pr checkout <n> / gh pr view --web
